input: Any commit that modifies /moves/king_e8.text must be signed by king_e8 and by at least fourteen other distinct Black agents' keys from /team/pieces, and must also modify /turn/ply.num, so that king_e8, which keeps going off plan, cannot send a move without near-unanimous team agreement.
response: always([+modifies(/moves/king_e8.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/king_e8.id)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/king_e8.text) -threshold("15", /team/pieces)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/king_e8.text) -modifies(/turn/ply.num)] false)
